feeds.title: Barb Raveling
feeds.description: Barb Raveling is a blogger and podcaster. She writes books on personal growth and weight loss Bible studies.

feeds.title: Faith and Health Connection Blog
feeds.description: A Christian perspective on health and wellness. Our ministry shares biblical truths about the link between faith and health, helpful articles, live online workshops & training.

feeds.title: Talking To My Weight Loss Counselor
feeds.description: Encouragement for struggling overeaters emphasizing a relationship with God to lose excess weight. Keep up with My weight loss counseling sessions with God.

feeds.title: Cathy Morenzie Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cathy Morenzie and I help amazing Christian women - just like you achieve your healthy weight. I will help you to find the motivation, desire, and laser-focus you need to achieve to get back to the great health you deserve to have.

feeds.title: The Holy Mess » Fitness
feeds.description: Fitness is a category at The Holy Mess with information about fitness motivation and Christian weight loss tips, healthy living, and physical activity. Authored by Sara Borgsted.

feeds.title: Lucy H. Delaney Blog
feeds.description: Lucy H. Delaney in her Blog documents inspiring stories of individuals who overcame obesity to become healthier persons through a focused diet, exercising, and faith in the lord. Lucy is a published author based in Washington and helps people achieve their goals through her initiative Common Cents Coaching.

feeds.title: Charlaine Martin » Weight Loss
feeds.description: Learn, understand and find solutions to your weight loss problems through spiritual paths in this section of the blog. Dive into deeper insights and special articles explaining how the Bible advocates health and wellness. Charlaine Martin is an author and writer for 'Life is always an adventure with God! and Personal trainer & owner of Be Totally Fit for Life.

feeds.title: Christians Weight Success
feeds.description: Covers articles on success stories, recipes, food reviews, keto workouts, advices and more. Christian personal trainer and author of Christians Weight Success blog will help you be successful at losing weight. He provides several training options to choose from, and selects that best fits your fitness goals.

feeds.title: FaithFueled Mom
feeds.description: This is a place where you can be uplifted, motivated, educated and entertained. I am not one of those people who have a favorite food, book, drink because I have a favorite for now mentality. I am all about God, love, fun, adventure and adding my two cents where it doesn't belong. I also kind of talk about weight loss, healthy eating and fitness alot because I love and it's my passion!

feeds.title: Take Back Your Temple Blog
feeds.description: Keep Up With The Latest Posts & Updates from the Take Back Your Temple Blog. Discussed topics include self-motivation, Anti-procrastination tips, Spiritual Talk, Diet tips, and more. At TBYT, We empower Christians to live fit, healthy and empowered in Christ. We desire each Christian to become the person God created them to be.

feeds.title: Teresa Shields Parker Blog
feeds.description: Christian Weight Loss Author, Coach & Speaker Teresa Shields Parker provides uplifting thoughts and insights to help women achieve their health and spiritual goals. She also morally transforms stories and anecdotes that help readers reaffirm faith and trust in God. Check out the latest posts for motivation.

feeds.title: Laura at WholyFit
feeds.description: Hi I'm Laura Monica, founder of WholyFit, a professional fitness certification organization equipping Christian leaders to offer Biblically-based, professional fitness programs for their community. My goal, as a worship leader and certified fitness professional for over 30 years, is to provide fitness programs that are also ways to worship God and meditate on Scripture.

feeds.title: CSG Fitness
feeds.description: CSG Fitness is here to offer motivation and advice to take you to your fitness goals! This blog provides an avenue to empower mothers towards fulfilling their God-given purpose both physically and spiritually.

feeds.title: Beth Ann Ziarnik Blog
feeds.description: Beth Ann Ziarnik Blog offers practical, biblical weight loss solutions for people looking to lose weight and get better. Read the latest posts to know how accepting and following God can help you reach a healthier place in life. Beth Ann Ziarnik is a self-confessed fan and author of romantic suspense books.

feeds.title: Erin L. Todd Blog
feeds.description: Intuitive Eating Blog for Christian Women. Erin Todd helps you deconstruct your beliefs about food and body and rebuild your health with Jesus as the cornerstone. Read insightful articles that talk about Body Image, Dieting, Strength, Foods, and Holiday eating from a Christian perspective.

feeds.title: Gospel Centered Health Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Mendy! As a Certified Counselor and follower of Jesus, here I tell women about mindful eating, dieting, mental health, and body love as the Lord wants us to. I am a certified professional counselor and the coordinator for Pleasant Valley Counseling Center in Liberty, Mo.

feeds.title: Amanda Kaldor Blog
feeds.description: Amanda Kaldor is a life coach encouraging women to strengthen their faith, better their health, and live an abundant life. In her blog, she shares the best effective practices and tips for weight loss and healthy eating habits, along with regular motivation through faith to help women overcome their mental and physical hindrances.

feeds.title: So Very Blessed » Christian Weight Loss
feeds.description: Take your weight loss to a deeper level by making Christ the center of your weight loss journey with the So Very Blessed Blog. Find healthy, effective tips to inculcate God's values into your eating habits. So Very Blessed is owned by Becky, a Christian Blogger passionate about helping women find their confidence in Christ through Scripture, prayer journaling, and gratitude.

feeds.title: PraiseMoves Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Dr. Laurette Willis. I'm passionate about faith & fitness, and supremely passionate and excited about getting the word of God into people in unique and uncompromising ways through Fitness, Meditation, Music.

feeds.title: Revelation Wellness » Weight Loss God's Way
feeds.description: Start your weight loss journey with biblical insights, and faith-based workouts provided through posts in our Christian Weight Loss category. Revelation Wellness is a non-profit ministry dedicated to educating and inspiring you to live healthy and whole in Christ so you can love others well.

feeds.title: Renee Dumont Conquer Cravings For Christians Blog
feeds.description: Learn how to use bible verses to help lose weight. Renee Dumont is a Christian life coach, singer, nutrition nut, fine artist, wife, and Mom. She is passionate to inspire and motivate Christian women through her own trials and triumphs to ignite their faith and find deliverance from craving sugar and emotional food struggles.
